name: Supervisor production integration design spec

current_flow_summary.pdf_extraction: Upload creates a user-owned FilingJob and Celery process_pdf_task runs the configured extraction pipeline, currently Azure DI in production mode.
current_flow_summary.normalized_rows: Extraction writes FinancialStatementPage and ExtractedDataItem rows with labels, values, statement type, years, template metadata, review flag, and optional confirmed_tag_id.
current_flow_summary.deterministic_mapping: Azure DI production mapping can populate template_field_id and statement/template metadata on extracted rows.
current_flow_summary.ai_mapping_suggestions: Qwen suggestions are persisted in llm_mapping_suggestions through run_llm_mapping_for_job with persist_suggestions=true and apply_high_confidence=false.
current_flow_summary.user_review: The Review Workspace displays persisted suggestions and requires explicit user Accept or Reject. Accept updates template-field metadata and is_reviewed, but does not automatically set confirmed_tag_id.
current_flow_summary.supervisor_fit: Supervisor should run after mapper suggestion generation and before human acceptance as a reviewer of mapper output, not as a mapper.

architecture.principle: Persist Supervisor review as advisory metadata attached to an AI suggestion or extracted row. It must not directly mutate final mapping.

recommended_indexes: unique active/latest idempotency index on job, item, suggestion, input signature, prompt version, and schema version
db_schema_design.storage_policy: Store payload hashes by default, not raw sensitive payloads. Raw payload storage requires separate approval, redaction, access control, and retention policy.

responsibilities: build production Supervisor payload from extracted row, mapper suggestion, candidates, concept cards, few-shot examples, and do-not-confuse notes
assert payload safety before any live call
call Supervisor LLM using SUPERVISOR_LLM_* configuration only
reused_components: 17D-B-hotfix-6 threshold classification logic after it is ported with tests

endpoints.purpose: List advisory Supervisor reviews for an owned job with status/risk/safe filters.
Run one mock Supervisor review for a suggestion or row in early phases.
Run or enqueue an idempotent batch review for a job.

ui_design.integration_point: AI Mapping Suggestions panel in frontend/src/review-workspace.jsx
behavior: show Supervisor badge beside each AI suggestion
show reason and issues in collapsible detail
show safe_to_accept and calibrated_safe_to_accept as advisory only
keep existing Accept and Reject controls unchanged
do not auto-click, auto-accept, or hide risky suggestions

allowed_payload: few-shot examples approved for production use

rollout_plan.scope: Backend persistence schema, model, migration, serializers, and migration tests only; no live LLM call
Backend service and API with mock Supervisor mode only
UI display integration with mock/persisted results only
Live Supervisor run button or batch job behind admin or feature flag

test_plan: DB model and migration idempotency tests
payload safety tests proving no auditor XML, parsed XML facts, gold answers, or evaluation labels are present
Supervisor review does not mutate extracted row mapping
confirmed_tag_id is never set by Supervisor review
safe_to_accept display does not trigger accept
failed provider/config call persists failed or skipped review safely
risks_and_open_questions: Live batch review can increase provider cost and rate-limit exposure.
Live batch review likely needs Celery for latency control.
Raw payload storage should remain disabled unless separately justified.
Review results can become stale when row, suggestion, candidates, prompt version, or schema version changes.
Live execution should initially be admin-only or feature-flagged.
Whether to store sanitized raw response previews should be decided separately.
recommended_next_feature: 17D-C-B - Backend persistence schema, SQLAlchemy model, serializer helpers, and migration tests only. No live LLM call, no endpoint behavior change, no UI change, and no auto-apply.
